objective: Ship India's open geopolitical evidence and decision operating system: an integrated, evidence-bounded IGRM Max v1 that turns versioned world state into proof-carrying India exposure, transmission, response and recovery products without licensing unsupported truth, causal, forecast, superiority or adoption claims.
category_definition: IGRM Max is not a larger scalar index or a collection of dashboards. It is a secure, bitemporal, rights-aware evidence operating system in which an event becomes a typed object, traverses a declared India dependency twin, preserves contradictions and uncertainty, compiles into role-specific products from invariant facts, and carries a machine-verifiable proof path to every public analytical clause.

budget.purchase_rule: No purchase without a written capability gain, rights analysis, price, cheaper alternative and no-buy consequence.
budget.legal_cost_assumption: Founder-accessible legal review is expected at zero cash cost; every review still records scope, reviewer, conflicts and independence limits and is never called independent unless it is.

allocation_envelope.buys: Independent coders, adjudication and study-quality control that no model or founder may self-supply.
Rights-cleared port-to-commodity inputs, acquisition experiments and bounded domain review for the first real dependency vertical.
Independent penetration, privacy and accessibility review plus hardware-backed key separation and remediation evidence.
Preregistered decision-task recruitment, incentives, masking, operations and result packaging.
Durable hosting, immutable archival copies, monitoring, rate control and backup retention.
Bounded methods editing, accessibility copy and human review of priority-language public explanations.
Documented remediation of a launch-critical validation, data-rights, security or reliability blocker only.

launch_boundary.must_ship: An integrated v1 of every registered pillar and engine, with explicit coverage and abstention where evidence is absent.
cannot_be_scheduled: completed evidence from a study whose registered observation window ends after launch
historical depth that did not exist by the authorization date
launch_boundary.rule: External and time-dependent outcomes publish their actual state and next evidence gate; they never become simulated accomplishments.

pillars.name: IGRM Atlas

pillars.name: IGRM Evidence Engine
pillars.launch_outcome: Typed claims, events, entities, evidence, rights, retrievals, transformations and signed release lineage.

pillars.name: IGRM Research Copilot
pillars.launch_outcome: Natural-language research over registered facts and executable transformations with clause-level refusal.

pillars.name: IGRM Observatory
pillars.launch_outcome: Event dossiers, hypothesis ledgers, transmission monitoring, scenario state and correction-aware alerts.

pillars.name: IGRM Benchmark Lab
pillars.launch_outcome: Frozen comparisons, causal/forecast experiments, decision-task protocols and a permanent win/loss register.

pillars.name: IGRM Institution
pillars.launch_outcome: Methods, rights, security, conflicts, corrections, continuity and external-pilot governance that can survive founder absence.

pillars.name: IGRM Distribution
pillars.launch_outcome: Research packages, board briefs, newsroom claim cards, institutional offline bundles, multilingual and accessible public/API surfaces.

engines.name: World-state engine
engines.launch_definition: Versioned actors, claims, events, entities, relationships, policies and observed responses with bitemporal state and correction history.

engines.name: Sensor fusion engine
engines.launch_definition: Semantically separate official, news, event, physical, trade, energy, market and public-attention lanes joined only through registered transformations.

engines.name: Knowledge time machine
engines.launch_definition: Replay facts, releases, alerts, evidence and models exactly as knowable at a selected historical cutoff.

engines.name: India Exposure DNA
engines.launch_definition: Living, coverage-bounded exposure vectors for covered states, sectors, firms, ports, corridors, commodities and critical public assets.

engines.name: Shock compiler
engines.launch_definition: Compile bounded event assumptions into exposure paths, ranges, missing links, substitutions and buffers without presenting a point scenario as a forecast.

engines.name: Causal discovery laboratory
engines.launch_definition: Pre-registered event studies and rival explanations that keep association, identification and causal claims distinct.

engines.name: Strategy and resilience engine
engines.launch_definition: Compare route, supplier, inventory, policy and diversification scenarios with assumptions and uncertainty, never directives or advice.

engines.name: Statistical and AI forecast laboratory
engines.launch_definition: A separated, no-lookahead laboratory with statistical and AI-ensemble models, strong naive baselines, proper scores, calibration and permanent losses.

engines.name: Verified intelligence copilot
engines.launch_definition: Natural-language plans compile into registered facts and executable transformations; models cannot author public facts, numbers, citations, dates or confidence.

engines.name: Institutional collaboration network
engines.launch_definition: Signed modules, corrections, replications, dissent and pilot evidence with disclosed identity, role, compensation and conflicts.

engines.name: Open geopolitical evidence standard
engines.launch_definition: A versioned public conformance specification for evidence, time, rights, claims, events, exposure, uncertainty, releases, corrections and refusal.

engines.name: India dependency twin
engines.launch_definition: A bitemporal, declared-universe network of physical, commercial and policy dependencies whose quantitative flows reconcile to source denominators, capacities and explicitly published gaps rather than inferred completeness.
launch_controls: every universe partitions its immutable input frame
quantitative flow edges preserve source units and denominator
conservation or reconciliation failures refuse publication
no registered source means the edge remains synthetic

engines.name: Contradiction and uncertainty graph
engines.launch_definition: Claims that disagree remain separately attributable graph objects, while source, mapping, temporal, model and missingness uncertainty are decomposed instead of collapsed into one confidence score or artificial consensus.

engines.name: Proof-carrying decision compiler
engines.launch_definition: One validated release compiles invariant registered facts into researcher, board, newsroom and offline-audit products whose reader-visible analytical clauses carry object, evidence and transformation proofs and whose unsupported clauses refuse.

engines.name: Federated evidence network
engines.launch_definition: External institutions can validate and sign scoped modules, corrections and private-data-derived claims without transferring raw restricted evidence, while identity, authority, conflicts, revocation and conformance remain machine-checkable.

engines.name: Institutional memory engine
engines.launch_definition: Assumptions, decisions, dissent, corrections, incidents, evidence availability and policy responses retain bitemporal lineage so a later user can distinguish what was known, chosen, revised and still unresolved.

engines.name: Zero-trust security and integrity plane
engines.launch_definition: The build, evidence, copilot and publication boundaries use least privilege, isolated signing keys, exact-commit gates, authenticated provenance, secret and privacy scanning, tamper-evident logs, recovery tests and explicit incident disclosure.
launch_controls: no model bot or single maintainer can both create and authorize a production release
production publishes only an exact green commit with authenticated artifacts
agents never receive founder release or restricted-source credentials
software bill of materials dependency review and provenance ship with releases
prompt injection cannot expand tools evidence rights or answer authority
backup restoration and incident response are exercised rather than documented only

engines.name: Open evaluation exchange
engines.launch_definition: Frozen blinded tasks, comparator outputs, scoring code, losses, abstentions and decision effects can be independently run and deposited so benchmark selection, hidden failures and favourable-only reporting cannot manufacture superiority.

required_capabilities.requirement: A geopolitical event is a typed and versioned object, not a headline.
Rumor, allegation, coded inference, official confirmation and realized disruption are distinct machine states.
News, official records, events, physical transmission, trade, energy, markets and public attention retain separate meanings.
Events traverse registered India dependency edges across routes, ports, commodities, sectors, states, firms and policy authority.
Every public link states what is known, effective date, source, rights state, coverage denominator and uncertainty.
Covered entities expose time-varying fingerprints, stale edges, unknowns and declared-universe coverage.
Users can vary duration and magnitude and receive paths, assumptions, missing links and ranges rather than a made-up forecast.
A past cutoff reconstructs the exact then-available knowledge state and prevents hindsight in research.
Competing hypotheses state supporting, contradicting and potentially falsifying evidence.
Observed post-event changes remain separate from defensible attribution.
One evidence graph can generate a research package, board brief, newsroom claim card and institutional offline audit bundle.
Open-ended questions compile from facts and transformations; an unsupported required clause forces abstention.
Researchers generate exact citable subsets and manifests.
Statistical and AI forecasts live outside descriptive instruments and publish calibration and losses.
Benchmark Lab publishes registered wins and losses against the full benchmark contract, never an overall superiority shortcut.
Major Indian-language question understanding and bounded public explanations preserve the same fact ledger.
The system keeps event, exposure, transmission, response and recovery as separate connected layers.
Usefulness is tested through frozen blinded decision tasks, not page views or testimonials.
A global shock can be evaluated against India-specific exposure and the architecture is country-portable.
External systems can test compatible evidence bundles against a public standard and adversarial fixtures.
Each Atlas universe reconciles included, excluded, unmappable, stale and unknown members to an authenticated source frame so coverage cannot be improved by silently shrinking the denominator.
Quantified dependency flows retain original units, denominator, capacity and time basis and either reconcile within a registered tolerance or refuse publication.
Conflicting source claims remain visible, attributable and unresolved until a registered resolution rule or authoritative correction changes their state.
Source, mapping, model, temporal and missingness uncertainty are carried separately; the system may not launder them into one unsupported confidence number.
Every reader-visible analytical clause identifies the exact objects, evidence, transformation and release from which it compiled, and semantic recompile rejects plausible resealed mutations.
Resilience scenarios check capacity, route, inventory, timing and substitution constraints before presenting a path as feasible and show which constraint or missing input blocks an answer.
Scenario results represent substitution ceilings, activation lags, inventory buffers and recovery timing as ranges or unknowns rather than instant frictionless replacement.
Researcher, board, newsroom, API and offline-audit products share one fact ledger; audience changes presentation but cannot change facts, dates, uncertainty or evidence lineage.
The system ranks data and mapping gaps by registered decision relevance and expected uncertainty reduction without pretending the ranking is a substantive policy recommendation.
External modules have scoped authority, signed bytes, revocation, conflicts, coverage and correction lineage and cannot expand the central release's rights or truth claims.
Restricted evidence stays encrypted and access-controlled; public outputs expose only rights-permitted metadata or derived values and retain an auditable access and redaction decision.
Every production release binds exact source, code, policy, schema, registry and artifact hashes to an authenticated release statement obtained outside the bundle.
No model, bot or single maintainer can both create and authorize a production release, high-impact correction or expansion of public claim authority.
Builds use least-privilege tokens, immutable dependencies, secret and malware scanning, an SBOM, provenance attestations and an exact-green-commit publication gate.
Untrusted source text and user prompts cannot grant tools, cross privacy boundaries, alter evidence authority, access signing secrets or bypass clause-level refusal.
Backups, restore procedures, key revocation, correction publication and incident disclosure are exercised and measured; an untested plan does not count as operational resilience.
Decisions, assumptions, dissent, incidents, corrections and unresolved questions are versioned alongside evidence so later users can replay institutional reasoning without hindsight.
Frozen blinded tasks, baselines, raw or rights-safe results, scoring code, abstentions and losses are independently rerunnable and permanently retained beside any reported win.

proof_rule: A deliverable may be complete only when its committed product surface, contract, negative/refusal behavior and tests are named together; external outcomes cannot be marked complete by repository evidence alone.
